title: Unverified Positive Isolation on Hydrocarbon Transfer Line
narrative_text: During scheduled maintenance on a hydrocarbon transfer line, work began after the upstream valve was closed. Positive isolation was not verified with a pressure test before flange breaking commenced. Residual pressure was present in the line. The worker positioned near the flange noticed a slight release and immediately stepped back. Work was stopped and the line was re-isolated and verified before continuing. No injury occurred.
exposure_description: Worker positioned near the flange at the moment of release
potential_consequence: Uncontrolled release leading to chemical exposure, flash fire, or projectile line-of-fire injury, up to fatal
evidence_sentence: Positive isolation was not verified with a pressure test before flange breaking commenced.

title: Worker Standing Beneath Suspended Derrick Rigging Load
narrative_text: Worker briefly stood beneath a suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool while repositioning rigging slings during a crane lift on the drilling pad. Rigging supervisor sounded the air horn and halted the lift immediately. Exclusion zone was not demarcated with physical barrier tape.
exposure_description: Worker directly beneath suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool
potential_consequence: Crush / blunt force trauma fatality from suspended load drop
evidence_sentence: Worker briefly stood beneath a suspended 2.5-ton manifold spool while repositioning rigging slings during a crane lift.

title: Vessel Entry Without Multi-Gas Atmospheric Clearance
narrative_text: Entry made into crude separator vessel before atmospheric gas testing was completed; crew was behind schedule on vessel desanding turnaround. Standby observer arrived 15 minutes after technician had already entered the vessel interior.
exposure_description: Technician inside unventilated separator vessel interior
potential_consequence: Asphyxiation or fatal H2S poisoning in confined vessel space
evidence_sentence: Entry made into crude separator vessel before atmospheric gas testing was completed; crew was behind schedule.

title: Hot Grinding Performed Near Flammable Vent Header
narrative_text: Angle grinding performed on structural steel beam located 3.5 meters from an open process vent stack without first confirming the area was free of flammable vapor. Continuous LEL detector was not deployed at spark path.
exposure_description: Grinding spark shower directly directed toward vent header
potential_consequence: Hydrocarbon vapor cloud explosion and catastrophic unit fire
evidence_sentence: Grinding performed near an open vent stack without first confirming the area was free of flammable vapor.

title: Elevated Derrick Access via Uncertified Makeshift Planking
narrative_text: Access to an elevated platform at 6.2 meters made via a make-shift scaffold plank instead of approved access equipment; no fall-arrest harness observed on rig hand. Work stopped by safety officer.
exposure_description: Rig hand traversing unsecured plank at 6.2m elevation
potential_consequence: Fatal fall from height onto steel wellhead manifold
evidence_sentence: Access to an elevated platform made via a make-shift platform instead of approved access equipment; no fall-arrest harness observed.

title: Permit-to-Work Isolation Points Discrepancy in Field
narrative_text: Permit-to-work was signed for compressor valve maintenance, but the isolation points listed on the PTW certificate did not match what was physically locked in the field. Tagged valve was bypass line BV-104 instead of main suction valve SV-104.

potential_consequence: High-pressure gas blowout (65 bar) causing fatal blast trauma and fire
evidence_sentence: Permit-to-work was signed, but the isolation points listed did not match what was physically isolated in the field.

title: High-Pressure Vessel Interlock Silenced Without Management of Change
